column1: # A HINT, never a correctness input: a file missing from this table is packed at
# the default weight (1), and a stale number only makes one shard finish sooner
# than another. Only files that cost more than the ~5s a cold kernel boot costs
# are listed; everything else is noise at this granularity.
# Seconds are the WORSE of the two CI platforms, because Windows is the long
# pole and a Windows runner pays 2-3x for the process spawns these files are
# made of. Every CI Python job passes --print-weights, so any green run's log
# has the numbers to rebuild this from:
